lines: Bills at Vikings on Tue 10 Nov, 9:15 am Perth. Both 6-1, Buffalo -3, total 44.5, on ESPN and ABC. Best game of the week.
Jacksonville is 6-2 after a 33-10 win in Baltimore. The Ravens are 4-5 and on a four-game slide.
Cleveland at New Orleans, Mon 9 Nov, 2:00 am Perth. The 5-3 Browns are getting 3 from a 2-5 Saints team, total 42.5.
Denver, 6-2 after beating Kansas City 28-24, is only -2.5 at Carolina. Chiefs host the 2-6 Jets as 9.5-point favourites.
San Francisco, 6-1, hosts the Raiders laying 10. Chicago, 6-2, hosts Tampa Bay by 6 on Sunday night.

pregame.matchup_read: Bengals at Falcons in Madrid, Sun 8 Nov, 10:30 pm Perth, on NFL Net. Cincy is 5-2 and laying 3 at the Bernabeu, total 52.5. Atlanta is 3-5 and coming off a 16-0 shutout loss at Tampa Bay.
storylines: Burrow is chasing a fourth straight win. He went 38/48 for 462 yards, 5 TD and 3 INT in the 43-36 overtime win over Tennessee.
Michael Penix Jr. went 8/24 for 125 yards and 4 INT in the Falcons' last outing, a 16-0 loss at Tampa Bay.
ESPN's preview frames it as Burrow's three-game streak against Penix and the Falcons in Madrid.
Pittsburgh sits 6-2 and leads the division, so Cincinnati cannot bank on sloppy wins piling up.
watch_for: Turnovers. Cincinnati gave it away four times against Tennessee, three of them Burrow picks, and still won.
The run game. 19 carries for 75 yards at 3.9 a pop last week, with Chase Brown at 12 for 55.
Red zone work. Bengals were 5-6 inside the 20 against the Titans, and that efficiency carried a leaky defense.
pregame.the_call: Bengals cover the 3 and the game goes over 52.5. Cincinnati put up 510 yards last week and Atlanta just got shut out with a four-interception day from its quarterback.

postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati won the yardage fight, 510 to 440, and kept converting: 7-of-10 on third down, 5-of-6 in the red zone. Four turnovers nearly gave it away before Burrow ran one in to settle it 43-36 in OT.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 38/48, 462 yards, 5 TD, 3 INT, plus 3 carries for 10 yards and the OT rushing score. Volatile, but he carried it.
Tee Higgins: 10 catches, 155 yards, 2 TD. Ja'Marr Chase added 11 for 141 and a score after, per ESPN, spiking his helmet in frustration early.
Tennessee's Tony Pollard went for 21 carries, 117 yards, 2 TD against a Bengals front that gave up 5.6 a carry.
postgame.division_meaning: Pittsburgh stays ahead at 6-2 after hammering Cleveland 27-6. Cincinnati sits 5-2 on a three-game run with the best point differential in the North at +48. Cleveland 5-3, Baltimore 4-4 and sliding.
postgame.the_take: A 1-7 team hung 36 on you and the defence allowed 6.3 a play. Ben Baby's line about needing a complete game is right. Burrow's three picks against Atlanta's level of team is survivable, elsewhere it is not.
